title: ScreenText
description: The text a reading of the screen's pixels found, and where, while the scope's perception.ocr_overlay is on. Each replaces the last; one with no boxes clears them, sent when the screen is about to change or the overlay is turned off. A viewer draws the boxes over the screen, never into it.

hold_ms.description: The longest a viewer keeps the boxes, unless another ScreenText comes first. 0: until one does.

boxes.description: In the order the text reads; empty to clear. At most SCREEN_TEXT_MAX_BOXES.

TextBox.description: A line of text read from the screen's pixels, and the box around it as shares of the screen.

confidence.description: How sure the reading is of the text.
